assets.caption: Maple Court Apartments — kitchen fire, Unit 4B

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My stove caught fire — the grease just went up! Flames are on the cabinets now!

lines.speaker: operator
lines.text: Stay calm. Do not throw water on a grease fire. Is anyone still inside the apartment?

beats.prompt: Before you send anyone, what's your priority question?

choices.label: Is anyone trapped or unable to get out?
choices.feedback: Knowing there are people inside changes the response priority.

choices.label: Get out now — how fast is it spreading?
Try to smother it with a lid or baking soda.
choices.feedback: Risky — never coach a panicking caller to fight a spreading fire.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My grandmother's in the back room — she can't move fast!

lines.speaker: operator
lines.text: Get low, get to her, and head for the nearest exit. Help is on the way.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's climbing the wall — I can't put this out!

beats.explanation: A spreading structure fire — with a possible trapped resident — requires FIRE DEPT: suppression plus search-and-rescue.
